description: Step 5. List clusters so the agent can pick one (or several) to approve before brief and roadmap generation. Returns short detail by default: {id, name, status} per cluster. Use detail="medium" for the full compact summary (pillarKeyword, briefGenerationStatus, briefCount, keywordCount, topKeywords, firstBriefId, description, productFit, relevanceScore, demand) or detail="full" for raw cluster objects. demand (when search data is connected): tag proven_demand (real impressions on the cluster's keywords) | covered (a page of ours already ranks top 3) | new (no data yet), plus impressions, bestPosition, bestPage and topQueries. Prefer proven_demand clusters; skip covered ones. Full keyword detail (keywordsMeta, contentMix, briefAssignments) is intentionally omitted at short/medium to keep context small — use cluster IDs with approve/reject tools directly. Supports server-side filtering: status (CSV of pending_review/approved/rejected), productFit (core/adjacent/out_of_scope), archetype (competitor), origin (CSV of pipeline/manual), q (text search over name/description/pillarKeyword). Multilingual brands: pass `language` (en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs) to filter to one language's clusters; omit to see every configured language's clusters mixed together.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

language.description: Filter to clusters in this content language (en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs). Omit to see every configured language's clusters mixed together.

origin.description: CSV of origins to filter by (pipeline, manual)

q.description: Text search over cluster name, description, and pillarKeyword

status.description: CSV of cluster statuses to filter by (pending_review, approved, rejected)

name: seo_list_clusters
